name: Claude Code: Extend Claude Code
scope: Canonical map of Claude Code extension mechanisms: plugins, skills, subagents, hooks, MCP, agent teams, rules, and CLAUDE.md.
why_useful: Use as the top-level taxonomy authority and to avoid conflating components that have different lifecycles and trust boundaries.

name: Claude Code: Create plugins
scope: Plugin anatomy, supported component directories, development, testing, validation, and distribution.
why_useful: Defines what qualifies as a native Claude Code plugin and supplies structural validation rules for ingestion.

name: Claude Code: Plugins reference
scope: Detailed plugin manifest, component, path, CLI, MCP, LSP, hook, and troubleshooting reference.
why_useful: Primary source for parsing plugin.json and for detecting invalid or obsolete plugin layouts.

name: Claude Code: Discover and install plugins
scope: Official and third-party marketplace discovery, installation, scopes, updates, and security warning.
why_useful: Establishes install semantics and the distinction between registering a marketplace and installing a plugin.

name: Claude Code: Create and distribute a plugin marketplace
scope: Marketplace JSON format, source types, version resolution, validation, hosting, and managed restrictions.
why_useful: Canonical schema guide for harvesting marketplace entries and resolving git, git-subdir, URL, npm, and local sources.

name: Claude Code: Extend Claude with skills
scope: SKILL.md format, locations, invocation, supporting files, subagent execution, tool grants, evaluation, and command compatibility.
why_useful: Canonical Claude Code skill rules; also records that custom commands were merged into skills while .claude/commands remains compatible.

name: Claude Code: Create custom subagents
scope: Custom subagent definitions, frontmatter, storage scopes, tools, permissions, models, and invocation.
why_useful: Defines a valid Claude Code subagent and helps distinguish agents from skills that fork into an agent context.

name: Claude Code: Automate workflows with hooks
scope: Practical hook creation patterns for command, prompt, HTTP, and agent hooks.
why_useful: Useful for capability descriptions and risk classification of extensions that execute automatically on lifecycle events.

name: Claude Code: Hooks reference
scope: Hook events, matchers, JSON input/output, exit codes, plugin hooks, MCP hooks, and asynchronous behavior.
why_useful: Canonical validation and security reference for hooks.json and settings-based hook declarations.

name: Claude Code: Connect to tools via MCP
scope: Claude Code MCP transports, scopes, configuration, authentication, prompts, plugin-provided servers, and management.
why_useful: Determines whether a generic MCP server is installable in Claude Code and how its configuration should be described.

name: Claude Code CLI reference
scope: Current Claude Code command-line flags and plugin/MCP management entry points.
why_useful: Allows generated install examples to be checked against current CLI syntax and flags stale npm-era instructions.

name: Claude Agent SDK: Agent Skills
scope: Using Agent Skills through the Claude Agent SDK.
why_useful: Captures SDK compatibility separately from native interactive Claude Code installation.

name: Claude plugin directory
scope: Anthropic-hosted directory of plugins, including Claude Code compatibility, verified labels, descriptions, and install counts.
why_useful: Best canonical popularity and compatibility surface for official-directory plugins; install counts are more meaningful here than stars alone.

name: Anthropic Claude Code repository
scope: Claude Code repository, bundled plugins, changelog, issues, examples, and demo marketplace.
why_useful: Primary source for bundled extensions, current deprecations, version history, and real plugin examples.

name: Anthropic bundled plugin marketplace manifest
scope: Machine-readable marketplace bundled in the Claude Code repository.
why_useful: Direct structured feed for bundled plugin names, descriptions, categories, authors, and source paths.

name: Anthropic official Claude Code plugins directory
scope: Anthropic-managed directory containing first-party plugins and pinned third-party plugin sources.
why_useful: Highest-value structured upstream for official and partner plugins; also documents that each linked plugin has its own license and trust profile.

name: Anthropic official plugins marketplace manifest
scope: Machine-readable official marketplace with descriptions, categories, authors, homepages, sources, refs, and commit SHAs.
why_useful: Preferred seed feed for deterministic source resolution and deduplication of official-directory entries.

name: Anthropic Agent Skills examples
scope: Anthropic skill examples, templates, marketplace packaging, specification pointers, and document skills.
why_useful: Canonical examples and useful seed set, but individual subdirectories have different licensing, including source-available document skills.

name: Anthropic knowledge-work plugins
scope: Open-source role-oriented plugins built for Cowork and documented as compatible with Claude Code.
why_useful: Adds non-coding use cases and demonstrates plugins combining skills, connectors, commands, and subagents.

name: Claude unified skills, connectors, and plugins directory help
scope: Claude account directory behavior across skills, connectors, plugins, organizations, and supported surfaces.
why_useful: Helps label Claude-wide entries that are not necessarily local open-source Claude Code extensions.

name: Agent Skills specification
scope: Open Agent Skills directory and SKILL.md specification.
why_useful: Normative baseline for parsing and validating portable skills before applying Claude Code-specific extensions.

name: Agent Skills specification repository
scope: Specification source, reference validator, documentation, issues, and proposals for Agent Skills.
why_useful: Machine-actionable validation reference and changelog for format evolution; code is Apache-2.0 and documentation is CC-BY-4.0.

name: Official MCP Registry
scope: Searchable canonical registry of published Model Context Protocol servers and versions.
why_useful: Preferred canonical identity and version source for MCP entries before enrichment from community directories.

name: Official MCP Registry repository
scope: Open-source registry service, API documentation, publishing workflow, schemas, and ecosystem roadmap.
why_useful: Supports programmatic ingestion and clarifies registry maturity, API versions, validation, and publish semantics.

name: Model Context Protocol servers repository
scope: Reference MCP server implementations and links to official and community servers.
why_useful: Canonical reference examples and a useful seed, while its README explicitly redirects broad discovery to the Registry.

name: MCP security best practices
scope: MCP attack vectors and mitigations covering authorization, confused-deputy risks, SSRF, sessions, and dynamic tools.
why_useful: Provides the risk vocabulary and review checklist for MCP server entries.

name: Official MCP Registry terms
scope: Terms governing use and publication of official MCP Registry data.
why_useful: Must be reviewed before bulk reuse, redistribution, or mirroring of registry metadata.

name: Claude Code marketplace JSON Schema
scope: JSON Schema for Claude Code marketplace manifests.
why_useful: Enables deterministic validation of harvested marketplace.json files and clear rejection reasons.

name: GitHub REST search API
scope: GitHub REST repository and code search endpoints, pagination, result caps, query limits, and rate limits.
why_useful: Essential crawler reference; notably exposes 1,000-result, repository-scope, default-branch, file-size, and rate-limit constraints.

name: GitHub Code Search syntax
scope: Code search qualifiers including path, language, repository, organization, symbols, regex, and boolean expressions.
why_useful: Basis for high-recall searches for marketplace.json, plugin.json, SKILL.md, agents, commands, hooks, and .mcp.json.

name: GitHub repository search syntax
scope: Repository search qualifiers for stars, forks, activity, topics, license, archived status, and metadata.
why_useful: Enables popularity and freshness slices without relying only on code search.

name: GitHub repository license API
scope: GitHub license detection and SPDX-aligned repository license endpoints.
why_useful: Primary automated license signal, with an explicit warning that root-file detection misses dependencies, subdirectories, and other license declarations.

name: GitHub REST API best practices
scope: Conditional requests, caching, polling avoidance, authentication, concurrency, and secondary rate-limit guidance.
why_useful: Operational guardrails for a recurring catalog refresh job that does not overload GitHub.

name: GitHub Acceptable Use Policies
scope: Restrictions covering automated bulk activity, scraping, information use, privacy, spam, and excessive bandwidth.
why_useful: Sets legal and operational boundaries; the crawler should prefer the API, avoid personal-data collection, and honor removal requests.

name: GitHub topic: claude-code
scope: Broad self-classified Claude Code repositories sortable by stars, forks, and update time.
why_useful: High-recall discovery and popularity input, but noisy enough to require artifact and license verification.

name: GitHub topic: claude-code-plugin
scope: Repositories self-classified as Claude Code plugins.
why_useful: Useful repository-level seed for plugin discovery beyond known marketplaces.

name: GitHub topic: claude-code-skills
scope: Repositories self-classified as Claude Code skill collections or individual skills.
why_useful: Strong skill-discovery surface that complements exact SKILL.md code searches.

name: GitHub topic: claude-code-hooks
scope: Repositories self-classified as Claude Code hook tooling or collections.
why_useful: Finds lifecycle automation that general plugin and skill lists frequently omit.

name: GitHub topic: claude-code-subagents
scope: Repositories self-classified as Claude Code subagent collections.
why_useful: Focused seed for agent-definition discovery and category coverage.

name: GitHub topic: model-context-protocol
scope: Repositories related to MCP clients, servers, SDKs, gateways, and tooling.
why_useful: Broad MCP discovery feed, requiring server/client/tool classification and Claude Code compatibility checks.

name: GitHub topic: mcp-server
scope: Repositories self-classified specifically as MCP servers.
why_useful: Higher-precision MCP-server seed than the broader protocol topic.

name: GitHub code search: Claude Code marketplace manifests
scope: Public code containing .claude-plugin/marketplace.json.
why_useful: Direct discovery of marketplace repositories, including those absent from directories and topic pages.

name: GitHub code search: Claude Code plugin manifests
scope: Public code containing .claude-plugin/plugin.json.
why_useful: Direct discovery of standalone plugins and plugin subdirectories in monorepos.

name: GitHub code search: Agent Skills
scope: Public SKILL.md files containing standard description frontmatter.
why_useful: High-recall long-tail skill discovery that is not limited to repositories with Claude-specific topics.

name: GitHub code search: Claude Code agents
scope: Markdown agent definitions under .claude/agents.
why_useful: Discovers project-scoped subagents that are rarely published as standalone repositories.

name: GitHub code search: Claude Code commands
scope: Legacy-compatible custom command files under .claude/commands.
why_useful: Captures the large pre-SKILL.md command ecosystem while allowing entries to be labeled legacy-compatible.

name: GitHub code search: Claude Code plugin hooks
scope: Plugin hook declarations in hooks/hooks.json.
why_useful: Finds plugins with automatic execution behavior and supports early security triage.

name: Awesome Claude Code
scope: Large hand-curated Claude Code list spanning skills, agents, plugins, hooks, status lines, tooling, and workflows.
why_useful: One of the most established high-signal community indexes and a strong source for descriptions and category ideas.

name: Awesome Claude Code Plugins by CCPlugins
scope: Curated native Claude Code plugins across commands, subagents, MCP servers, hooks, and use-case categories.
why_useful: Plugin-focused list with a broad functional taxonomy and contribution flow.

name: Awesome Claude Plugins by Composio
scope: Curated Claude Code plugins bundling commands, agents, hooks, and MCP servers.
why_useful: Independent plugin list useful for cross-checking omissions and duplicate descriptions.

name: Awesome Claude Skills by Travis VN
scope: Curated Claude skills, resources, tools, and workflow extensions with a Claude Code emphasis.
why_useful: Popular skill-specific list with contribution guidelines and a mature category structure.

name: Awesome Claude Skills by Composio
scope: Curated Claude and cross-agent skills, MCP resources, and workflow tools.
why_useful: Large independently maintained skill index that surfaces popular cross-agent repositories.

name: Awesome Claude Code and Skills by GetBindu
scope: Broad collection of Claude Code projects, skills, security tools, domain packs, and skill-development tooling.
why_useful: High-recall secondary source with useful per-entry capability notes and explicit quality-oriented contribution criteria.

name: Awesome Claude Code by subinium
scope: Curated tools, configurations, skills, plugins, MCP servers, and workflows.
why_useful: Compact cross-check source with practical groupings for configurations versus installable extensions.

name: Awesome Claude Code Skills by itgoyo
scope: Star-ranked Claude Code skills, plugins, tools, and capability extensions.
why_useful: Useful popularity-oriented discovery source, but star counts and generated summaries require independent verification.

name: Awesome Claude Code Subagents by VoltAgent
scope: Large installable collection of specialized Claude Code subagents grouped into domain plugins.
why_useful: Primary high-volume seed for subagent definitions, with clear categories, contribution rules, and an MIT license.

name: wshobson Agentic Plugin Marketplace
scope: Large multi-harness marketplace of Claude Code plugins, agents, skills, commands, and orchestrators.
why_useful: High-quality structured source with native marketplace metadata, component catalogs, validation tooling, and a rich functional taxonomy.

name: Claude Code Templates
scope: CLI and catalog for agents, commands, settings, hooks, MCP integrations, skills, and project templates.
why_useful: Broad component coverage and machine-installable categories make it valuable for discovering non-plugin artifacts.

name: Everything Claude Code
scope: Production-oriented agents, skills, hooks, rules, MCP configs, command shims, memory, and security tooling.
why_useful: Popular real-world configuration corpus and migration reference across Claude Code and other harnesses.

name: Daymade Claude Code Skills
scope: Documented marketplace of production-oriented Claude Code skills and skill bundles.
why_useful: Strong example of marketplace packaging, skill validation, demos, and bundle-level installation semantics.

name: Agentic Awesome Skills
scope: Large cross-agent skill catalog with Claude Code plugin distribution, bundles, CLI, and local MCP discovery.
why_useful: Very high recall for SKILL.md content and bundles; requires filtering for Claude Code readiness and original provenance.

name: Agents, Skills, and Plugins collection by Eric Grill
scope: Curated collection of Claude Code skills, agents, plugins, and upstream repositories.
why_useful: Secondary cross-reference for less-visible collections and author attribution.

name: Awesome MCP Servers by punkpeye
scope: Large community-curated list of local and remote MCP servers across many categories.
why_useful: One of the most established broad MCP discovery sources and a key complement to the official Registry.

name: Awesome MCP Servers by TensorBlock
scope: Large community collection of MCP servers and related tools.
why_useful: Independent high-recall feed for cross-checking servers missing from the official Registry or other lists.

name: Awesome MCP Servers by habitoai
scope: Community-curated MCP server and tool list.
why_useful: Additional deduplication and discovery source for the MCP long tail.

name: ClaudePluginHub
scope: Automated directory of Claude Code marketplaces, plugins, and component-level metadata with trust signals.
why_useful: Extremely high recall for public marketplace manifests and useful component extraction; duplicates and auto-discovered noise must be filtered.

name: Claude Marketplaces
scope: Searchable directory of Claude Code skills, plugin marketplaces, and MCP servers.
why_useful: Large-scale discovery surface and useful estimate of ecosystem breadth; counts and classifications need canonical-source verification.

name: Claude Plugins community registry
scope: Community registry and CLI for Claude Code plugins and Agent Skills.
why_useful: Adds installation-oriented metadata and helps find standalone skills not packaged in conventional marketplaces.

name: Claude Code Marketplace
scope: Community directory and installable marketplace spanning agents, commands, hooks, MCP servers, and skills.
why_useful: Useful category-specific feed and source of links to other marketplace collections.

name: built4claude
scope: Broad directory of Claude plugins, MCP servers, skills, agents, workflows, prompt libraries, and learning resources.
why_useful: Provides non-developer and workflow-oriented coverage often missing from GitHub-only lists.

name: AgentHub Claude Code marketplace
scope: Searchable Claude Code plugin marketplace with component types, authors, licenses, and repository links.
why_useful: Useful enrichment source for explicit license and component metadata, subject to verification against upstream repositories.

name: Skills Playground
scope: Claude Code skill marketplace and MCP server directory with GitHub-oriented browsing.
why_useful: Secondary discovery source for popular and category-specific skills.

name: Claudeable
scope: Curated Claude Code directory covering skills, MCP servers, subagents, hooks, CLAUDE.md configs, commands, output styles, and rules.
why_useful: Good breadth across artifact types that large skill/plugin indexes underrepresent, with concise human-written use-case descriptions.

name: ClaudSkills open SKILL.md registry
scope: Large automatically mined registry of Claude Code and cross-agent SKILL.md submissions.
why_useful: Very high-recall skill source with categories and source links; automated counts and quality claims require local verification.

name: Claude Skills Hub directory
scope: GitHub-backed Agent Skills directory for Claude Code and other compatible agents.
why_useful: Useful discovery and cross-agent compatibility source with direct upstream links.

name: skills.sh Agent Skills directory
scope: Large install-oriented directory of Agent Skills sourced from public repositories.
why_useful: Important cross-agent source for popular SKILL.md packages and installation demand signals.

name: MCP.so
scope: MCP server, client, CLI, workflow, and Agent Skills marketplace with categories and rankings.
why_useful: Broad discovery and cross-linking source for MCP servers and adjacent reusable capabilities.

name: PulseMCP server directory
scope: Large MCP server directory with official/reference/community classification, popularity estimates, and recency sorting.
why_useful: High-recall MCP discovery with useful provider and freshness facets; popularity estimates are non-canonical.

name: Glama MCP registry
scope: MCP server, connector, and tool-level index with build, license, quality, and safety metadata.
why_useful: Tool-level search and continuously rebuilt server metadata provide capabilities that repository-only indexes miss.

name: Smithery
scope: MCP server registry, hosting, connection metadata, CLI installation, and security scan signals.
why_useful: Useful for MCP deployment and tool metadata enrichment; hosted and closed-source entries must be separated from open-source servers.

name: MCPFind
scope: MCP server search, comparisons, installation guidance, and multi-client configuration.
why_useful: Useful secondary discovery and setup-verification source, especially for Claude Code-specific install instructions.

name: MCP Servers directory
scope: Searchable categorized directory of featured, official, and community MCP servers.
why_useful: Human-browsable cross-check for provider attribution and category coverage.

name: Awesome list manifesto
scope: Widely used standards for focused scope, curation, descriptions, categories, contribution rules, and list licensing.
why_useful: Provides a quality bar for building an actual curated awesome list rather than publishing an unreviewed scrape.

name: OSI approved licenses
scope: Canonical Open Source Initiative list of approved licenses and SPDX identifiers.
why_useful: Supports a defensible verified-open-source gate instead of treating every public repository as open source.

name: SPDX License List
scope: Standard license identifiers, canonical URLs, exceptions, and OSI/FSF flags.
why_useful: Canonical normalization source for license fields and mixed SPDX expressions.

name: OWASP MCP Security Cheat Sheet
scope: MCP security controls covering tool poisoning, authentication, authorization, secrets, sandboxing, and monitoring.
why_useful: Independent security checklist for risk badges and reviewer guidance.

name: Malicious Agent Skills in the Wild study
scope: Large-scale empirical study of malicious Agent Skills and released analysis artifacts.
why_useful: Evidence that SKILL.md and bundled resources must be treated as an executable supply-chain surface, not harmless documentation.

name: Skill-Inject benchmark
scope: Benchmark and analysis of prompt-injection attacks embedded in agent skill files.
why_useful: Supports explicit prompt-injection review and cautions against relying only on conventional malware scanners.
